1	# Sprint 2 — Dato Handoff: Booking Engine Schema
2	
3	Migration file: `supabase/migrations/20260415000004_booking_engine.sql`
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Table Inventory
8	
9	| Table | studio_id FK | Critical Columns | RLS Scope |
10	|-------|-------------|-----------------|-----------|
11	| `artists` | CASCADE | `profile_id` (nullable), `status`, `specialties[]`, `commission_default_pct` | `user_studio_ids()` |
12	| `services` | CASCADE | `slug`, `duration_min`, `base_price_cents`, `deposit_cents`, `is_public` | `user_studio_ids()` |
13	| `service_artists` | (no direct col) | `service_id + artist_id` PK, optional price/duration overrides | `user_owns_service_studio(service_id)` |
14	| `clients` | CASCADE | `fts` (generated tsvector), `email` partial-unique, `total_sessions`, `consent_minor` | `user_studio_ids()` |
15	| `bookings` | CASCADE | `end_at` (generated), `booking_token` (unique UUID), `EXCLUDE USING gist` | `user_studio_ids()` |
16	| `booking_photos` | CASCADE | `client_id` (denormalized), `kind`, `storage_path` | `user_studio_ids()` |
17	| `waitlist_entries` | CASCADE | `preferred_dates` (daterange), `offered_booking_id` | `user_studio_ids()` |
18	| `booking_page_settings` | CASCADE | UNIQUE(studio_id) — one row per studio | `user_studio_ids()` |
19	
20	All 8 tables have:
21	- RLS enabled with SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE policies
22	- `created_at` + `updated_at` timestamps + `handle_updated_at()` trigger
23	- Indexes on every FK column
24	
25	---
26	
27	## EXCLUDE USING gist: Artist Double-Booking Prevention
28	
29	### What it is
30	A PostgreSQL exclusion constraint on the `bookings` table:
31	
32	```sql
33	EXCLUDE USING gist (
34	  artist_id WITH =,
35	  tstzrange(scheduled_at, end_at, '[)') WITH &&
36	)
37	WHERE (status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'in_progress'))
38	```
39	
40	### What it prevents
41	Two active bookings for the same artist whose time ranges overlap cannot coexist in the database. This is enforced at the storage engine level — no application-layer race condition is possible.
42	
43	Example: Artist booked 14:00-16:00 (confirmed). Attempting to INSERT a booking at 15:00 for the same artist raises `exclusion_violation` immediately.
44	
45	### The '[)' half-open range
46	`tstzrange(start, end, '[)')` = inclusive start, exclusive end. Back-to-back bookings that exactly touch (first ends at T, second starts at T) are NOT considered overlapping. This means artists can be booked consecutively with zero gap.
47	
48	### When it fires
49	- On INSERT of any booking with status in `('pending', 'confirmed', 'in_progress')`
50	- On UPDATE that changes `scheduled_at`, `duration_min`, `artist_id`, or `status` to an active value
51	- Does NOT fire for status `'cancelled'`, `'completed'`, `'no_show'`
52	
53	### In `public_create_booking` RPC
54	The function wraps the INSERT in a `BEGIN/EXCEPTION WHEN exclusion_violation` block and returns `{"error": "time_slot_unavailable"}` to the caller. Koda should surface this to the user as "that time is no longer available."
55	
56	### Requires btree_gist
57	The `btree_gist` extension is required to combine a scalar UUID column with a range column in a single GiST index. Enabled in this migration.
58	
59	---
60	
61	## Public Booking RPC Contract
62	
63	All 6 functions are `SECURITY DEFINER`. Callable by `anon` and `authenticated` roles. None expose internal `studio_id` from the request body — the studio is always resolved server-side from the slug.
64	
65	### 1. `public_get_studio_by_slug(p_slug text) → jsonb`
66	Returns: `{id, name, slug, logo_url, brand_color, timezone, locale}` or `null`
67	Used by: `app/book/[studioSlug]/page.tsx` — first call to render the page header.
68	
69	### 2. `public_get_services_for_studio(p_studio_id uuid) → SETOF jsonb`
70	Returns: array of `{id, name, slug, description, duration_min, base_price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_required, requires_consultation, color, sort_order}`
71	Only returns `is_public = true` services. Internal services are never exposed.
72	
73	### 3. `public_get_artists_for_studio(p_studio_id uuid) → SETOF jsonb`
74	Returns: array of `{id, display_name, bio, portfolio_url, avatar_url, specialties, sort_order}`
75	Only returns `status = 'active'` artists. No commission or financial data exposed.
76	
77	### 4. `public_get_availability(p_artist_id uuid, p_service_id uuid, p_date date) → jsonb`
78	Returns:
79	```json
80	{
81	  "date": "2026-05-15",
82	  "artist_id": "...",
83	  "duration_min": 90,
84	  "slots": [
85	    { "start": "2026-05-15T09:00:00+00:00", "end": "2026-05-15T10:30:00+00:00" },
86	    ...
87	  ]
88	}
89	```
90	Sprint 2 stub: 09:00–21:00 window in studio timezone, step = service duration, already-booked active slots removed.
91	Sprint 6 will replace with schedule-aware version (artist_schedules table).
92	
93	### 5. `public_create_booking(p_token uuid, p_studio_slug text, p_service_id uuid, p_artist_id uuid, p_scheduled_at timestamptz, p_client_data jsonb) → jsonb`
94	`p_client_data` shape: `{first_name, last_name, email, phone}`
95	
96	Success response:
97	```json
98	{ "booking_id": "...", "booking_token": "...", "status": "created" }
99	```
100	Idempotent: if `p_token` already exists as a `booking_token`, returns `{"status": "existing"}`.
101	Overlap error: `{"error": "time_slot_unavailable"}`
102	
103	Side effects:
104	- Upserts a `clients` row (matched by `lower(email)` within studio)
105	- Inserts a `bookings` row with `status='pending'`, `source='public'`
106	
107	### 6. `public_get_booking_by_token(p_token uuid) → jsonb`
108	Returns denormalized confirmation payload:
109	```json
110	{
111	  "booking_id": "...",
112	  "booking_token": "...",
113	  "status": "pending",
114	  "scheduled_at": "...",
115	  "end_at": "...",
116	  "duration_min": 90,
117	  "price_cents": 15000,
118	  "deposit_cents": 5000,
119	  "deposit_paid": false,
120	  "studio": { "name": "...", "slug": "...", "logo_url": "...", "timezone": "..." },
121	  "artist": { "display_name": "...", "avatar_url": "..." },
122	  "service": { "name": "...", "duration_min": 90 },
123	  "client": { "first_name": "...", "last_name": "...", "email": "..." }
124	}
125	```
126	Returns `null` if token not found.
127	
128	---
129	
130	## Client Search Strategy
131	
132	Two complementary search mechanisms are on the `clients` table:
133	
134	### Full-text search (tsvector)
135	- Generated column `fts` (STORED) — `to_tsvector('simple', first_name || last_name || email || phone)`
136	- GIN index `idx_clients_fts`
137	- Query pattern: `WHERE fts @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $1)`
138	- Best for: multi-word queries, finds "Jane Smith" from "jane smith" or "smith jane"
139	
140	### Trigram similarity (pg_trgm)
141	- GIN indexes on `first_name`, `last_name`, `email` using `gin_trgm_ops`
142	- Query pattern: `WHERE first_name % $1` (similarity) or `WHERE first_name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'`
143	- Best for: partial matches, typo tolerance — "Jone" matches "Jones" with similarity ~0.6
144	
145	### Recommended Koda query for client search:
146	```sql
147	SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, phone
148	FROM public.clients
149	WHERE studio_id = $1
150	  AND (
151	    fts @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $2)
152	    OR first_name  % $2
153	    OR last_name   % $2
154	    OR email       ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
155	  )
156	ORDER BY similarity(first_name || ' ' || coalesce(last_name,''), $2) DESC
157	LIMIT 20;
158	```
159	
160	---
161	
162	## Known Gotchas for Koda
163	
164	### booking_token in URL params
165	- Store the `booking_token` UUID in the URL: `/book/confirmation?token=<uuid>`
166	- Never use `booking_id` in public URLs — that's an internal UUID
167	- The token is globally unique; no `studio_id` scoping needed for public lookups
168	- Pass it as the `p_token` idempotency key to `public_create_booking` on submit
169	
170	### Never trust client-sent studio_id
171	- All public RPCs resolve `studio_id` server-side from `studio_slug` or `artist_id`
172	- Koda must NOT accept `studio_id` from the browser request body for public booking flows
173	- `studio_id` is only trusted when it comes from `auth.uid()` via RLS or SECURITY DEFINER
174	
175	### end_at is GENERATED ALWAYS
176	- Never include `end_at` in INSERT or UPDATE queries — Postgres computes it
177	- In the TypeScript Insert/Update types it is intentionally absent
178	- It IS in the Row type because you can read it
179	
180	### service_artists has no studio_id column
181	- RLS uses `user_owns_service_studio(service_id)` helper
182	- When inserting a service_artist row, the trigger `enforce_service_artist_same_studio` validates that both the service and artist belong to the same studio — it will RAISE EXCEPTION otherwise
183	
184	### clients.fts is a generated tsvector
185	- It is NOT a plain text column — do not SELECT it or try to display it
186	- The TypeScript Row type intentionally omits it (a tsvector has no JS equivalent)
187	- Use it only in WHERE clauses via `@@ plainto_tsquery(...)`
188	
189	### waitlist_entries.preferred_dates is a Postgres daterange
190	- The Supabase JS client returns dateranges as strings: `"[2026-05-01,2026-06-30)"`
191	- Parse it with a utility function; do not try to cast it directly as a Date
192	- When inserting: pass as a string in range literal format: `'[2026-05-01,2026-06-30)'`
193	
194	### Double-booking UX
195	- `public_create_booking` returns `{"error": "time_slot_unavailable"}` on exclusion_violation
196	- The booking form should re-fetch availability slots and show an error — not retry silently
197	- An RPC returning `{"error": ...}` comes back as HTTP 200 (Supabase RPC success), not 4xx — check the `error` key explicitly
198	
199	### Deposit payment (Sprint 4)
200	- `deposit_payment_id` is nullable TEXT — Dodo payment ID stored here after payment confirmation
201	- `deposit_paid` / `deposit_paid_at` are updated by the Dodo webhook handler (not app code)
202	- Do not build deposit payment UI in Sprint 2; stub the field
203	
204	### Storage path for booking_photos
205	- Use the `design-assets` bucket (created in bootstrap migration)
206	- Path convention: `{studio_id}/{client_id}/{booking_id}/{kind}/{filename}`
207	- `storage_path` stores the path within the bucket, not the full URL
208	- Generate signed URLs server-side for display; never expose raw storage paths publicly
209	
210	---
211	
212	## Stats
